context_files_read.purpose: Controlling repository safety and artifact discipline rules.
key_findings: Machine-readable artifacts are the product; charts, HTML, and markdown are only views.
Missing metrics must be encoded as MISSING or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON and values must not be invented.
P14_SCALE_1000_OPTIN_DRYRUN is not automatic and must not be run without explicit opt-in.

context_files_read.purpose: Phase-loop entrypoint and P14 opt-in boundary.
key_findings: Automatic loop ends at P13; P14 requires VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN.
Report layer may read artifacts but must not become source of truth.

context_files_read.purpose: Loop harness policy and anti-regression criteria.
key_findings: All analysis and reports must read machine-readable artifacts, not rendered markdown.
1000+ must remain dry-run/resource/planner by default.
Historical artifact rewrites without rerun evidence or recorded reason are blocking.
L05 must render audit results, metric catalog, coverage matrix, scale ladder, and P13 timing into readable views.
Required outputs include index.html, coverage_matrix.csv, coverage_heatmap.svg, scale_ladder.svg, p13_timing_waterfall.svg, missing_metrics.csv, and provenance_graph.json.
All visualizations must be generated from JSON, JSONL, or CSV artifacts and must not hardcode values.
L05 constraints explicitly forbid P14, valkey_e2e_gate.py, fault_safety_gate.py, and fault_failover_gate.py.
Existing report tests cover P09 package rendering, not loop-engineering report artifacts.
The handoff already flags brittle SVG/CSV golden tests and absent render_audit_report.py as risks.

context_files_read.purpose: Baseline harness result for the stage.
key_findings: Previous harness status is PASS with 182 tests passing and schema checks passing for audit, provenance, metric catalog, coverage matrix, and P13/P14 scale audit artifacts.
The command list does not include L05 rendered report generation yet.
Stage is IN_PROGRESS in DESIGN phase with no blockers.
Recorded constraints require source-driven views, explicit missing metrics, no P14 or real/fault wrappers, and preservation of L00-L04 behavior.

key_findings: Scale ladder report is PASS and records 50/100 real evidence paths and observed node counts.
Rung metrics include memory and command counters that should be read from JSON, not hardcoded.

They do not validate loop-engineering report outputs, coverage heatmap, scale ladder SVG, or P13 timing waterfall.
Renderer reads analysis_summary.json and writes HTML, markdown, CSV, SVG, and report index artifacts.
It preserves MISSING rows for P09, but is hardwired to P09 labels and does not satisfy L05 output requirements directly.

findings.description: Rendered report views could become accidental source-of-truth if L05 does not emit a source-driven report index and provenance links for every HTML, CSV, and SVG output.
evidence: AGENTS.md states machine-readable artifacts are the product and rendered reports are only views.
provenance_graph.json marks legacy P09 rendered view nodes source_of_truth=false but shows source_count 0 for those view nodes.
L05 required rendered outputs are not present yet under artifacts/loop_engineering/reports.

evidence: L05 manifest explicitly says all visualizations must be generated from JSON/JSONL/CSV artifacts and cannot hardcode values.
coverage_matrix.json currently has 60 entries, 17 covered entries, 12 real coverage entries, 10 dry-run entries, and 43 missing/skipped cells that should be read dynamically.
scale_ladder_report.json and timing breakdown artifacts contain measured 50/100 values that should drive scale_ladder.svg and p13_timing_waterfall.svg.

findings.description: Missing metrics could be fabricated or visually hidden if CSV/SVG/HTML rendering filters to only measured rows.
evidence: metric_catalog.json summary records 2 missing metrics, 20 skipped metrics, and 2 no-baseline entries.
coverage_matrix.json has many SKIPPED_WITH_REASON cells, including most 1000-dry-run surfaces.

findings.description: SVG and golden tests can become brittle if they compare full serialized SVG strings, timestamps, exact ordering from dictionaries, or formatting-only details instead of semantic content.
evidence: read_context.md flags SVG/CSV golden tests as a known risk.
Existing tests/report/test_report_rendering.py validates limited P09 output fragments rather than a semantic loop-report renderer contract.
L05 needs coverage_heatmap.svg, scale_ladder.svg, and p13_timing_waterfall.svg, each with data-dependent visual geometry.

findings.description: P14 or real-wrapper leakage would violate the stage boundary if rendering invokes P14, valkey_e2e_gate.py, fault_safety_gate.py, or fault_failover_gate.py instead of reading committed artifacts.
evidence: read_context.md explicitly forbids P14 and the real/fault wrappers for L05.
p13_p14_scale_audit.json records P14 as SKIPPED_WITH_REASON, dry_run_only true, real_valkey_coverage false, and default_gate_result_present false.
coverage_matrix.json keeps 1000-dry-run coverage dry_run_only and real_valkey_coverage false.

findings.description: Historical artifact rewrites could make L05 reports look cleaner while invalidating L01-L04 provenance and anti-regression guarantees.
evidence: 03_HARNESS_POLICY.md blocks historical artifact edits that make results appear passing without rerun evidence or recorded reason.
p13_p14_scale_audit.json records historical P13 manifest and command drift as explicit non-blocking findings.
L05 should write new report artifacts only and must not rewrite artifacts/phases or artifacts/gates as a rendering convenience.

proposed_harness.name: loop_report_renderer_source_contract
proposed_harness.acceptance: Each L05 output is regenerated from declared JSON/CSV inputs, and changing a source fixture changes the corresponding rendered value without editing renderer constants.

proposed_harness.name: loop_report_missing_metric_visibility
proposed_harness.acceptance: MISSING, SKIPPED_WITH_REASON, and NO_BASELINE style entries are present in missing_metrics.csv and visible in index.html and coverage_heatmap.svg with their reasons.

proposed_harness.name: loop_report_provenance_links
proposed_harness.acceptance: Rendered HTML/CSV/SVG outputs are source_of_truth false and have explicit source artifact links and sha256s in a report index or updated provenance graph.

proposed_harness.name: loop_report_p14_boundary
proposed_harness.acceptance: The renderer never imports or executes real/fault gate wrappers, never requires VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN, and renders 1000 only as dry-run/planner coverage.

proposed_harness.name: loop_report_semantic_svg_tests
proposed_harness.acceptance: SVG tests parse XML and assert semantic labels, row counts, statuses, dimensions, and source-derived values instead of full byte-for-byte strings.

proposed_harness.name: loop_report_historical_artifact_guard
proposed_harness.acceptance: CI or loop validation confirms L05 did not modify artifacts/phases, artifacts/gates, codex gate controls, schemas, or scripts except for intentional renderer/harness additions.

implementation_plan.step: Add a loop-engineering report renderer that reads only committed machine-readable artifacts and writes the L05 required views.
implementation_plan.rationale: Keeps rendered views reproducible and scoped to L05 without touching historical phase/gate evidence.

implementation_plan.step: Emit source metadata for every rendered output.
implementation_plan.rationale: Prevents rendered views from becoming source-of-truth and lets audits trace output values back to source artifact hashes.

implementation_plan.step: Add tests that use small fixtures for coverage matrix, metric catalog, scale ladder, P13 timing, P14 boundary, and missing semantics.
implementation_plan.rationale: Validates behavior without running P14 or real/fault wrappers.

implementation_plan.step: Run baseline, renderer, schema checks, report tests, CI tests, and anti-regression checks.
implementation_plan.rationale: Documents the exact commands used and preserves loop-stage auditability.

acceptance_criteria: All required L05 outputs exist under artifacts/loop_engineering/reports.
coverage_matrix.csv row counts and statuses match coverage_matrix.json entries, including 1000-dry-run SKIPPED_WITH_REASON cells.
missing_metrics.csv includes metric_catalog missing/skipped/no-baseline entries with explicit reasons and never substitutes numeric values for missing data.
coverage_heatmap.svg, scale_ladder.svg, and p13_timing_waterfall.svg are generated from source artifacts and expose MISSING/SKIPPED status text where applicable.
index.html identifies source artifacts and makes clear that rendered views are non-authoritative.
provenance output or report index records source artifact paths and sha256s for every rendered output.
No command invokes P14, scripts/valkey_e2e_gate.py, scripts/fault_safety_gate.py, or scripts/fault_failover_gate.py.
No historical artifacts under artifacts/phases or artifacts/gates are rewritten by L05 rendering.
Tests validate semantic SVG/CSV/HTML content rather than brittle complete rendered strings.
risks: Rendered HTML/CSV/SVG may be treated as authoritative if source links and source_of_truth=false metadata are not explicit.
Hardcoded summary counts can silently diverge from audit, coverage, metric, scale, and timing JSON inputs.
Filtering out missing/skipped rows can fabricate coverage by omission.
Full-string golden SVG tests can fail on harmless formatting changes or pass while missing semantic source checks.
P14 may leak into reports as real 1000-node evidence if dry_run_only and real_valkey_coverage flags are ignored.
Historical phase/gate artifacts could be rewritten to make reports easier to render, invalidating prior audit evidence.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not parse rendered markdown, HTML, or SVG as source data.
Do not hardcode node counts, timing values, coverage counts, metric values, or P13/P14 statuses that already exist in JSON artifacts.
Do not replace null, absent, MISSING, SKIPPED_WITH_REASON, or NO_BASELINE values with zeros or estimated values.
Do not run P14 or set VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN.
Do not execute scripts/valkey_e2e_gate.py, scripts/fault_safety_gate.py, or scripts/fault_failover_gate.py for L05.
Do not rewrite artifacts/phases or artifacts/gates to make report generation simpler.
Do not weaken schemas, gate locks, phase manifests, or CI controls to pass L05.
notes: No blocker was found for L05 design. Approval is conditional on keeping L05 as a pure artifact-rendering stage: source-driven views only, explicit missing semantics, no P14 or real/fault wrappers, no historical evidence rewrites, and semantic renderer tests before completion.
